name: Albaredo per San Marco (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Albaredo per San Marco drawn in outline (a tower and trees above the lion of Saint Mark) with the name above.
history: Municipal flag of Albaredo per San Marco, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Albaredo per San Marco arms — tower and trees above the lion of Saint Mark, in outline, with the name above
